+qhi = np.array([m.joint(n).range[1] for n in jn]) - 0.02
+R0 = s.data.site_xmat[sid].reshape(3,3).copy()
+
+def ik(pos, qseed=None, R=R0):
+    if qseed is None: qseed=s.data.qpos[qadr].copy()
+    qseed=np.clip(qseed,qlo,qhi)
+    def err(q):

+    res=least_squares(err,qseed,bounds=(qlo,qhi),max_nfev=60,ftol=1e-5)
+    return res.x,np.linalg.norm(res.fun[:3])/5
